reason: Caught by review of #1325. Introduced by 1fa84b07d6595784d940ee8f3287eb31986fedf2, where the Word module opened an imported package and drafted typing with mutateWord without asking whether the package proof allows any edit, so a split or first words on a read-only import were saved. detect fires on a mutateWord call with no readOnly check on the opened package before it, and stays quiet once draftCandidate refuses a read-only package.
